title: Cargo Net – Heavy-Duty Trailer Net for Safe Transport
descriptionHtml:
Keep the load in place – all the way home

A bump in the road or a strong gust of wind is enough to blow loose items off the trailer. It's both dangerous for other road users and expensive if something gets damaged on the way.

A net that covers everything

The heavy-duty polyethylene cargo net stretches over the load and keeps everything in place – from moving boxes to garden waste. The elastic material shapes itself to the load and the tight mesh stops even smaller items from slipping out.

Features

  • Heavy-duty, elastic polyethylene net
  • Tight mesh that keeps even small items in place
  • Fits trailers, roof racks and truck beds
  • Withstands weather, sun and repeated use
  • Easy to attach with hooks around the edge

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
